disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in violation of any provision of the architecture statutes or board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the holder of such certificate of registration is practicing in the commonwealth in violation of any provision of sections sixty A to sixty J, inclusive, or of any rule or regulation promulgated under authority thereof by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate of registration was obtained by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: such certificate of registration was obtained by fraud or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Money or thing of value (other than lawful fees) was paid or received to secure issuance of the certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any money or thing of value, except fees prescribed or authorized by said sections, was paid or received to secure the issuance of such certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the holder of such certificate of registration has been guilty of fraud or deceit, or of gross negligence, incompetence or misconduct, in the practice of architecture

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or allowing the official seal to be affixed to plans, specifications, or drawings not prepared by the architect or under personal supervision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the holder of such certificate of registration has permitted or suffered his official seal to be affixed to any plans, specifications or drawings not prepared by him or under his personal supervision by his regularly employed subordinates

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affixing signature to plans, drawings, specifications, or instruments not prepared by the architect or in the architect's office under immediate responsible direction, or permitting name to be used to help a non-architect evade the law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the holder of a certificate has affixed his signature to plans, drawings, specifications or other instruments of service which have not been prepared by him or in his office, or under his immediate and responsible direction, or has permitted his name to be used for the purpose of assisting any person, not an architect, to evade the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an undisclosed interest in the manufacture, sale, or installation of any component or process in a project for which the person is the architect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the holder of such certificate has an interest in the manufacture, sale or installation of any component or process in a project for which he is the architect, which interest he has not disclosed to his client

definition_quote.value: No person shall, directly or indirectly, engage in the practice of architecture in this commonwealth, except as hereinafter set forth in section sixty L, or use the title ''architect'', ''registered architect'', ''architectural designer''
definition_quote.quote: No person shall, directly or indirectly, engage in the practice of architecture in this commonwealth, except as hereinafter set forth in section sixty L, or use the title ''architect'', ''registered architect'', ''architectural designer''

seal_required.quote: Every registered architect shall have a seal of a design authorized by the board. All plans and specifications and reports prepared by a registered architect, or under his supervision shall be stamped with the impression of such seal.
